provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Star Wars: Imperial Assault Learn to Play (Fantasy Flight Games, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Choose the Imperial player (the most experienced); everyone else plays Rebel heroes for the whole campaign
Each Rebel picks a Hero sheet, figure and Class deck; basic Item cards (no XP cost) faceup
steps.note: A single Rebel player controls 2 heroes

steps.text: Imperial player picks an Imperial Class deck and lays out its basic Class card
Agenda deck: the Imperial player picks 6 Agenda sets and shuffles those 18 cards
Side Mission deck: each hero's red card, 4 green cards of the heroes' choice and 4 random gray cards, unseen
2 heroes: each gets a Legendary Reward card
3 heroes: each gets a Heroic Reward card
Dice, Condition and Supply decks, damage, strain and condition tokens within reach
Each hero takes an activation token, ready side up
Build the map and deploy figures as the mission shows
A hero with 2 activation tokens can't take a second activation until every hero has had a first
